name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-09-18.18.2): > *That -* > > *(a) further consideration of the bills be postponed until Tuesday, 26 November 2024; and* > > *(b) on Tuesday, 26 November 2024:* > >> *(i) the bills be called on prior to the first order of government business,* >> >> *(ii) the questions on all remaining stages of the bills be put at 1 pm,* >> >> *(iii) divisions may take place between 1.30 pm and 2 pm until consideration of the bills has concluded, and* >> >> *(iv) paragraph (b)(ii) operate as a limitation of debate under standing order 142.*
